summary_1line: A pigeon laments his missing wife, who—captured by a fowler—urges him from the cage to show hospitality to the very hunter who trapped her.

image_candidates.scene_text: A weary fowler sleeps beneath a vast blue-hued tree filled with countless birds while stars glitter across the clear night sky.
A lonely pigeon on a branch cries into the night sky, lamenting for his missing mate as the forest darkens around him.
Inside the hunter’s cage, the she-pigeon gazes up at her husband on the branch and urges him to show hospitality to the very fowler who captured her.
